name: adx_strong_trend_pullback_5s
author: adapted from Gemini Quant
thesis: Exploits institutional accumulation. When ADX > 25, the market is in a structural trend. Retail traders attempt to pick tops/bottoms, causing shallow pullbacks to the 20 EMA. These pullbacks are absorbed by trend-following institutional algos. This persistent imbalance creates the edge.
mechanism: ADX measures the strength of directional order flow. Rising ADX indicates that one-sided institutional flow is dominating the order book. The trend persists because the institutional order is not yet complete, and trend-following algorithms amplify the existing direction, creating persistent moves that last until the flow exhausts.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
